propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate took per-key rate limiting to general availability on all production endpoints on 21 February 2024 after a signed launch checklist, and chaired the post-launch review.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the launch and review, and the post-launch review carries the signed checklist, the release date and three weeks of production figures.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran a six-week early-access programme with nine customers on a separate preview endpoint.
propositions.rationale: The resume places the programme on a separate preview endpoint.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate wrote the changelog entry, migration guide and customer email for the rate-limiting launch.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the launch material directly.

expectedGap: The candidate supplied usage data and the commercial team set the tier limits, so the candidate's part in pricing or packaging is limited to that input.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the general-availability release with its date, signed checklist and post-launch review; keep the early-access programme on the preview endpoint as a pre-release programme.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask what part the candidate played in packaging or pricing decisions beyond supplying usage data.
